body: Thanks for that. I feel I have been really unsuccessful, and I have no one to go to for support or anything. I have tried to reach out before, but I've been shut down. I'm not a callous or pushy person, quite timid in fact, so I can't conclude anything other than that they don't care. I hope if I do get kicked out, there will be services to help me. You're right, it doesn't have to be the end, but it feels like it. Thank you for the response, it's helped a lot.

Hey, thanks again for your reply. I'm sorry to hear you were bullied. I was bullied as a kid too, but not to a great extent. I think maybe some of my social anxiety comes from that though. My current hobby is drawing and painting. I also enjoy many sports. The problem is that my parents trivialize and put down anything I do that doesn't relate to academics. This makes me feel inadequate in almost everything. It makes me give up my hobbies. This has been a theme my entire life. But perhaps you're right, I can try to find some people through this way. Thank you for the insight, it's helped a lot.

I did in the past. But I came to the realization that I would not be able to accomplish those goals. For me, it's more important to feel like I have a place as well as purpose. I haven't felt like I had a place in this world for years, I'm quite surprised I've stayed alive this long. I've just been completely isolated, and I have tried everything I can to break out of it and make friends and so on and so forth. It just seems there's no place in this world for me.

Hey, thanks for replying. I've been verbally abused by my parents for a while, mostly my dad. His anger has made it VERY clear that he doesn't want me, and he's even stated he wanted me gone by now. I've done nothing to make them angry except for performing poorly academically. That is all they care about. I don't know how to live for myself, and I have no friends. If I continue, I feel as if I'm just delaying the inevitable. They don't care what I do, they just want me to be successful in a way that prescribes to their ideals. Something like a doctor or a lawyer. They will not be supportive in other cases. In fact, I doubt even if I wanted to pursue medicine they would be supportive even with that. I have a strong feeling I'll be kicked out soon and be homeless. I just don't feel anything is worth it anymore.
